## Data Profile SQL

```sql
SELECT
  orders.status AS "orders.status",
  COUNT(*) AS "orders._count",
  CAST(AVG(orders.customer_id) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.customer_id_avg",
  CAST(AVG(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.amount_avg",
  COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date_count_distinct"
FROM orders AS orders
GROUP BY
  orders.status
LIMIT 3
```
